name: version-range-mcp
description: Which versions a dependency range accepts in npm, Cargo, pip, Maven, NuGet, Gradle, Composer, RubyGems, and which one gets installed.
long_description: Answers 'does this version match this constraint?' exactly as each package manager would. The engines are ports of each tool's own code, checked against the real tools. No network access, no key, no dependency. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).

tools.name: check_version_constraint
tools.description: For each version: accepted by the constraint or not, and the version the tool would install.

tools.name: compare_across_ecosystems
tools.description: The same constraint in every package manager, grouped by identical result.

tools.name: sort_versions
tools.description: Versions sorted in a given package manager's order.
